# fonts

Fonts: IBM Plex Sans for the UI (IBM's face for technical, instrument-like interfaces; its Light cut is the thin sans for annotations), Lilex Nerd Font for the terminal (a coding face with ligatures), JetBrains Mono Nerd Font for the lock screen and notifications, Inter for the bar, Noto for coverage and emoji.

They are not part of the palette.

## Reference
